text:
marta_docs: Opened PR #958 to clean up on-prem/VPC docs: reorder install steps, add a Calico policy template, iptables raw table hint, and PKCS#11 smoke tests. Preview: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/958

sam_net: Nice. Can we standardize on the local KMS proxy port? I suggest 8443 to avoid collisions. Also use a template var for the HSM subnet: {{HSM_SUBNET}}.

lee_sec: Security notes: 1) Mention vendor update endpoints for HSMs and show how to disable in air-gapped setups (example: echo "VENDOR_UPDATE_URL=" > /etc/hsm/config). 2) Recommend a dedicated k8s SA `hsm-client-sa` with minimal RBAC. Add NTP sync note for certs.

alan_ops: Ops report: move CA/certs install before adding /etc/hosts entries. We had customers hit `curl: (60) SSL certificate problem` when hosts pointed at LB before CA installed. Also include conntrack tuning pointer for high throughput.

marta_docs: Updated branch: Calico example now uses {{HSM_SUBNET}} and port 8443. I added an iptables raw NOTRACK example and a short PKCS#11 check that references PKCS11_LIB env var (no PINs in docs). CI: linkcheck OK, asciidoc OK, spellcheck 1 warning.

ci-bot: docs-ci: linkcheck ✅, asciidoc ✅, spellcheck ⚠️ 1 warning (passive voice).

marta_docs: Thanks all  I'll address the wording and merge after re-run.
